summary: Iteration 6 — Full backend + frontend verification of the Web Dojo multi-page/template/snippets/find-replace/design-tokens/analytics/project-templates feature set. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 13 new test cases covering /api/snippets CRUD (create, reverse-created list ordering, delete, 404), /api/templates CRUD (create/list/delete/404), analytics endpoint shape + preview counter increment (+2 after two /api/preview hits), Project pages/active_page_id/template round-trip, per-page SEO meta injection into <head> on preview, template header/footer wrapper toggle honored by preview, and pre-existing publish/projects/components regression. All 30 backend tests pass in 2.54s. Playwright test on the public preview URL (Cloudflare ingress) exercised the whole builder end-to-end: shell mounts, PagesBar Home tab visible, page-add-btn adds a second tab, rename via page-name-home updates label, page-status-home switches workflow color, per-page state preserved across switches (Home shows 3 'Card title' cards, Page 2 shows 0, back to Home still 3), SEO description persists after Done, template-toggle checkbox turns on wrapper, Cmd+F/find-btn opens FindReplaceModal with a live match count (14 matches for 'div'), all four scope selectors + Replace all click do not crash, assets-btn opens Design tokens and Colors tab detected 5 hex tokens after inserting a card row, left-tab-snippets → snippets-tab → save creates a new snippet row via /api/snippets, templates-btn → save creates a project template via /api/templates and Use template resets the workspace to a copy (project name toggles to 'TEST_tpl_… — copy'), publish/undo/redo/save/load all still clickable. Only actionable finding: the Save toast persisted on screen at test end (below the Open modal); non-blocking.

issues: The page-tab div's central area is fully occupied by the inline rename <input>, so a normal Playwright center click on the tab hits the input (which stopPropagation's) and does not switch the page. Users clicking the tab label between the letters may hit the input by accident; the visible click-target for switching is only the small status dot / margins. Consider making the input read-only until a double-click (or providing a dedicated switch button).

critical_code_review_comments: PagesBar tab switching UX: the child <input data-testid=page-name-*> covers the middle of the tab and calls e.stopPropagation, so clicking the tab label doesn't switch pages — only clicking the tiny status dot or the margins does. Add an explicit click target for switching (e.g., the status dot area now has no dedicated switch button) or gate the input behind a double-click.

Builder.jsx newPage() calls switchPage(id) twice via setTimeout(…,0) — the workaround suggests a state-batching race. Consider deriving activePageId directly from the setPages result to remove the double call.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_snip_*, TEST_tpl_*, TEST_it6_* snippets/templates/projects. Frontend test artifacts (snippet, template, saved project 'TEST_tpl_… — copy') were deleted via /api after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is fully green (30/30). If PagesBar tab click UX gets changed, remove the position={x:3,y:3} click workaround in the Playwright script — tab clicks currently hit the child <input> which stopPropagation's. Cloudflare still swaps backend 502 bodies at the public ingress; the publish-unreachable test hits http://localhost:8001 directly to inspect the JSON body.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking issues. The PagesBar UX quirk described in critical_code_review_comments is a minor testability/discoverability concern, not a functional defect — users can still switch pages via the tab margins or status dot.
